envVars.KHUDEBARTA_API_KEY: Khudebarta API key, from the Khudebarta portal under the account's API settings, issued together with the secret key. Read from apps/api/.dev.vars in local dev and from a Workers secret (`wrangler secret put KHUDEBARTA_API_KEY`) in production. Unset, every send through this provider throws SmsError("provider_error") before the request is built; set but wrong, the gateway rejects the send and it surfaces as SmsError("account_error") with providerCode "-66".
envVars.KHUDEBARTA_SECRET_KEY: Khudebarta secret key, issued in the Khudebarta portal alongside KHUDEBARTA_API_KEY. Read from apps/api/.dev.vars in local dev and from a Workers secret (`wrangler secret put KHUDEBARTA_SECRET_KEY`) in production. Unset, every send through this provider throws SmsError("provider_error") before the request is built; set but wrong, the gateway rejects the send and it surfaces as SmsError("account_error") with providerCode "-67".
envVars.KHUDEBARTA_API_URL: Base URL of the Khudebarta gateway, without a trailing path. Optional: it defaults to https://portal.khudebarta.com:3770, and only an account Khudebarta assigned a different host or port needs to set it. It must use HTTPS. Cloudflare Workers strip a custom port from a plain `http://` subrequest, so an http URL with a port silently lands on port 80 and every send fails against the wrong service. The provider does not check this for you.
